name: GOV monad-protocols: PermissionsTransferred (Curvance CentralRegistry)
description: Curvance CentralRegistry: PermissionsTransferred(string,address,address) emitted by a contract tagged mf-privileged. Default severity high. The privChangeGuard Web3 Action decodes the change, classifies the holder (EOA, EIP-7702, Safe, timelock) and checks for prior notice.
